title: Uber Backend (Educational Architecture)
description: Built an educational C++ backend inspired by Uber’s architecture using a custom modular framework. Implemented three multithreaded microservices and centralized logging via a Singleton pattern for clarity, maintainability, and observability.

title: Uber Rider App (Frontend)
description: Designed and developed a rider-facing Flutter app integrated with a modular C++ microservices backend. Implemented JWT-based authentication, real-time ride status tracking, and location updates with maps integration.

title: C++ Modular Framework
description: Created a high‑performance C++ framework for distributed systems with integrated Kafka, RabbitMQ, and Uber H3 for geospatial indexing. Includes a robust utilities toolkit and a Singleton Logger for console/file logging.

title: WhatsApp UI Clone (Mobile)
description: Replicated the core WhatsApp interface to demonstrate UI/UX implementation and component-based mobile architecture.

title: Instagram Clone (Mobile)
description: Built a mobile clone with profile management, image upload/deletion, and post interactions (likes) to demonstrate full-stack mobile workflows.

title: Plan + Approve Web-Search AI Agent (CLI)
description: Implemented a stateful AI agent that plans, pauses for approval, and conditionally performs web search. Used LangGraph for interrupt/resume, conversation summarization, memory checkpointing, and structured JSON planning with detailed logging.

title: eHealth Medical System (University Final Project)
description: Developed a full‑stack web and mobile platform for physiotherapists and clients to manage profiles, appointments, and medical reports with SDLC and unit testing.

title: Employee Management System (University Group Project)
description: Built a centralized web application to streamline monthly payroll processing and automate payslip distribution.

title: CRUD Web Application
description: Created a web app for direct database manipulation through the UI to showcase CRUD operations and real‑time interactions.
